title: Mimosa Mornings Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutMimosa Mornings ~ 81 Gulf Breeze Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. Mimosa Mornings rents Weekly only (Sat-Sat only during Spring Break and Summer rate seasons). Mimosa Mornings is a luxurious 5,252sf home located in the private, Gulf Trace neighborhood that is updated annually! With 5 bedrooms/6 full baths/1 half bath, and an additional 3,177sf of outdoor porches, Mimosa Mornings will sleep up to 16 guests and offers an elevator, private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies), hot tub, poolside cabana, ample parking and expansive views of the Gulf from multiple porches. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives guests ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy; 25 steps from private neighborhood beach access. Winner of the 2009 APEX Builder Industry Association award for best design and best new construction; soaring 10' ceilings throughout. PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Need more room? Take a peek at Jada's Dare, next door to Mimosa Mornings - newly built in 2021, same owner, same luxurious appointments! Jada's Dare is a 5-bedroom, 5.5 bath home sleeping 10, with its own private pool and hot tub! Mimosa Mornings borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. *Please note - there are several large homes under construction on the beach in front of Mimosa Mornings and elsewhere in the neighborhood as of March 2024. Beach construction does obstruct views as shown in photos. Photos will be updated once construction along the beach has been completed. Ground Level: Garage (1 bay), washer/dryer, cabana with ping pong table and seating, full bath with walk-in shower, outdoor kitchen with fridge, sink. First Level: Living room with Queen sofa sleeper, laundry room, 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, balcony. #1 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, soaking tub, walk-in shower, double vanity #3 En-suite Bunk Room has 3 Bunks (6 XL Twins), tub/shower, double vanity Laundry Room has washer/dryer, folding table, sink, ice machine. Second Level: Main living room, dining table for 8, bar seating for 6, fully equipped kitchen, butler's pantry, powder room, 1 bedroom, 1 bath, screened sun porch, balcony. #4 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, soaking tub, walk-in shower, double vanity Third Level: 1 bedroom, 1 bath, balcony #5 En-Suite (Master) bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower Please note – no local channels on any Smart TV’s, streaming services available with guest account login. Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured). Entertainment Features 7 Flat Screen Smart TVs (no local channels), 2 Blu-Ray/DVD players, board games, puzzles, books, movies Distinctive Features Expansive Gulf views Private heated saltwater pool (heating fee applies) Hot tub Poolside cabana with seating, full bath, outdoor fridge, sink, charcoal grill, gas grill, ping pong table Elevator 2 living rooms 2 washers/dryers Butler's pantry Beach Gear Credit General Features Garage parking for 1 car, driveway parking for 4 vehicles 4 King beds, 3 Bunks (6 XL Twins), 1 Queen sofa sleeper 6 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, iron, ironing board, 5 hair dryers, outdoor gas and charcoal grills w/ grill utensils, outdoor porches, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, butler's pantry, coffee maker, gas range, refrigerator with ice dispenser, separate ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, 2 washers, 2 dryers. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Downtown Grayton (1.6 miles) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
